rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The project figures line 3 (Form 1040 line 9, $32,936.00) on every return; the model left it blank because no one is covered by a retirement plan (i1040gi p. 97, IRA Deduction Worksheet, "If you checked 'No' on line 1a (and 'No' on line 1b if married filing jointly), skip lines 2 through 6, enter the applicable amount below on line 7a (and line 7b, if applicable), and go to line 8"). Line 6 reads line 5 only when lines 2 through 6 are completed (ira.lines2to6), so line 6a is $0.00 in both and the deduction (line 12a, $0.00) agrees. A blank is not the number zero. No change to the data.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The filer made no traditional IRA contributions for 2025 (line 11a $0.00, on which the model agrees), and the worksheet is for figuring the deduction for such contributions (i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, "If you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, you may be able to take an IRA deduction ... Use the IRA Deduction Worksheet to figure the amount, if any, of your IRA deduction"); the project shows the printed lines 7a and 7b as $0.00 for a return without traditional contributions (ira.any_trad) and the applicable amount, $7,000, otherwise (person.ira_line7). The model entered the applicable amount by the line 1 instruction (p. 97, "enter the applicable amount below on line 7a ... $7,000 if under age 50 at the end of 2025"). Line 12a, the smallest of lines 7a, 10 and 11a, is $0.00 either way, and the model agrees on it. No change to the data.

Ruling: model error; classm.ira.2 is a joint return with no traditional IRA contribution (person.ira_owner false for both; branch ira.any_trad:false), the spouse covered through a SEP. The model filled the worksheet as if it were used (1b Yes); its value is not evidence for the line as defined.

Ruling: representation; project retained. No one on the return made traditional IRA contributions (both persons' traditional contributions are $0.00; ira.any_trad false), and the IRA Deduction Worksheet is used to figure a deduction for traditional IRA contributions (i1040gi, Line 20, IRA Deduction: "If you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, you may be able to take an IRA deduction"); the project shows line 7 as zero when the worksheet has nothing to limit (ira.line7a/7b take ira.zero), while each person's own line 7 ($8,000.00, age 50 or older) is carried in person.ira_line7. The model entered the applicable amount ($8,000) for a worksheet nobody completes. Lines 12a and 12b (the smallest of line 7, 10 and 11) and Schedule 1 line 20 are zero either way, and no printed amount a filer uses differs. Not evidence.
